feeds.title: Ms. Magazine
feeds.description: Ms. Magazine is a publication that discusses women's issues, social justice, and feminism in a broad sense. It includes essays, opinion pieces, and articles from a wide range of authors, including academics, journalists, and activists. The magazine examines politics, society, history, and current affairs from a feminist angle in an effort to spur discussion and action on women's rights and gender equality.

feeds.title: Black Feminisms Blog
feeds.description: Blackfeminisms.com is a digital project centered on Black women and feminism in the African Diaspora. The vision for Black feminism is to serve first and foremost as an outlet for the cultivation of scholarship that centers on Black women. As part of this mission, Black feminism includes the Black Feminist Digest, a series that summarizes research about Black women. These summaries provide a gateway into understanding the lives of Black women.

feeds.title: Autostraddle
feeds.description: Founded in March 2009 by Riese Bernard and Alexandra Vega and still run by a dedicated team of passionate weirdos, Autostraddle is an intelligent, hilarious & provocative voice and a progressively feminist online community for multiple generations of kickass lesbian, bisexual & otherwise inclined ladies. Follow to get News, Entertainment, Opinion, Community and Girl-on-Girl Culture.

feeds.title: Feminists for Life of America
feeds.description: Feminists for Life of America recognizes that abortion is a reflection that our society has failed to meet the needs of women. We educate pro-life and feminist movements about our rich, pro-life feminist history. As Feminists for Life, we are motivated to free women from abortion through resources and support.

feeds.title: The New Feminist
feeds.description: The New Feminist is an online and digital intersectional feminist magazine that thrives on asking the right questions. They aim to empower women while eradicating the stigma that surrounds the feminist movement.

feeds.title: the fatal feminist
feeds.description: The Fatal Feminist is a blog by Nahida Nisa that explores the intersections of Islam, feminism, and spirituality through essays, poetry, and critical reflections. It addresses themes like gender justice, racism within Muslim communities, reproductive rights, and power structures.

feeds.title: The Fawcett Society
feeds.description: Articles on violence against women and girls, women and poverty, equality law and justice, suffrage history, crisis in care, women and politics, gender norms and stereotypes, feminist activism, women in work and intersectional feminism. The Fawcett Society is the UK's membership charity campaigning for gender equality and women's rights at work, at home and in public life.

feeds.title: Empowr » The Feminist Blog
feeds.description: The Empowr blog is a feminist platform by the ethical fashion brand Empowr, blending activism with personal storytelling. It covers topics like queer liberation, body autonomy, rape culture, and bisexual visibility, often written by founder Emilia Joensalo.

feeds.title: African Feminism Blog
feeds.description: AfricanFeminism (AF) is a pan-African feminists digital space exploring African Feminisms through lived experiences.

feeds.title: Pretty Progressive
feeds.description: Articles on feminism, shopping, politics and progress. We here at Pretty Progressive are trying to achieve a base where everyone no matter what race, religion or creed can be heard and is given a fair platform.

feeds.title: Reductress
feeds.description: The first and only satirical women's magazine, Reductress was founded in 2013 by Beth Newell and Sarah Pappalardo. The mission of Reductress is to take on the outdated perspectives and condescending tone of popular women's media.

feeds.title: Women's History Network Blog
feeds.description: Women's History Network Blog seeks to be a resource for anyone with a passion for women's history. The Women's History Network is a national association and charity for the promotion of women's history and the encouragement of everyone interested in women's history.

feeds.title: Neda Aria Blog
feeds.description: I write I create, I build worlds in my imagination. Writing is my soul, creating is my passion. I write to explore the human mind, I write to reveal what's beneath that beautiful mask of yours. I uncover the darkness within. I dare to free words, I dare to be brave, I dare to say what others afraid to say.

feeds.title: Feminist Studies in Religion Blog
feeds.description: The FSR Blog is a place where studies regarding the intersections between feminism and religion are shared with a wide audience.

feeds.title: The Feminist Shop Blog » The Feminist Hub
feeds.description: The Feminist Hub is the editorial blog of The Feminist Shop, an ethical feminist retail space based in the UK. It serves as both a resource hub and a platform for feminist ideas, blending thoughtful commentary with activism-aligned products.

feeds.title: Rewire News Group
feeds.description: News, commentary, analysis, and investigative reporting on critical reproductive and sexual health, rights, and justice issues. Rewire News Group is a nonprofit media organization dedicated to reshaping the national dialogue on all things sex by making it more inclusive, positive, and centered on justice.

feeds.title: Feminist Magazine
feeds.description: Feminist Magazine on KPFK is the weekly Southern California radio show of news, views, politics, and culture with an intersectional feminist perspective. For over 40 years Feminist Magazine has been a space for women's voices & feminist stories - from grassroots to global - airing news and opinions you don't hear on mainstream media.

feeds.title: Skepchick
feeds.description: Skepchick was founded by Rebecca Watson in 2005 to discuss science and skepticism from a woman's perspective. Over the years, it's grown to be a home to dozens of writers who tackle those issues as well as progressive politics, feminism, and social justice.

feeds.title: Fit is a Feminist Issue
feeds.description: Fit Is a Feminist Issue started with conversation blog co-founders Sam and Tracy have been having for more than two decades about feminism and fitness.

feeds.title: Dear Clementine
feeds.description: Feminism. Movies. Polemic. Tarot. What can I say, I contain multitudes.

feeds.title: Invisible Women
feeds.description: Invisible Women by Caroline Criado Perez is a powerful exposé revealing how a pervasive gender data gap, where men's experiences are assumed to be universal leads to everyday and life-threatening oversights for women.

feeds.title: FEM Newsmagazine
feeds.description: Fem is UCLA's first and only feminist publication since 1973, and is committed to upholding the standards of honest journalism while advocating for a socially just community.

feeds.title: The Glinner Update
feeds.description: All the latest on gender woo from beloved Internet personality, Glinner

feeds.title: The Mary Sue
feeds.description: The Mary Sue is the premier destination for entertainment geeks, female or otherwise. Coverage includes movies, comics, tv/movie fandom, and other cool stuff.

feeds.title: FEMINIST GIANT
feeds.description: Feminist Giant is a bold, global feminist blog and newsletter created by Mona Eltahawy that delivers uncensored commentary on gender, politics, and power.

feeds.title: GenderMatters.in
feeds.description: Covers articles related to gender, development, society, culture and politics in India, South Asia and the global South. GenderMatters.in, a project from Centre for Social Research in New Delhi, India. Its core mission is to restructure gender relations toward a humane, equitable, gender-just society and focus attention toward empowering women, protecting and ensuring women's rights and understanding social issues from a gender perspective.

feeds.title: Mary Harrington
feeds.description: Mary Harrington is a British writer who shares her views on feminism through her blog Reactionary Feminist.

feeds.title: Julie Bindel's writing and podcasts
feeds.description: Misogyny: what is it and why won't it die?

feeds.title: Matriarchal Blessing
feeds.description: Catharsis for your feminist awakening.

feeds.title: Listening in the Dark with Amber Tamblyn
feeds.description: Creative-minded community and cultural catharsis. Full of feminism and always algorithm-free.

feeds.title: Anti-Porn Feminists
feeds.description: An anti-porn feminist blog typically critiques the pornography industry from a radical feminist perspective, arguing that it perpetuates misogyny, objectification, and violence against women.

feeds.title: The Good Chat
feeds.description: If you're a feminist looking for nuance, who wants to disrupt inequality or just a human with big feelings trying to live by their values, then this newsletter is for you. Created by activist and writer Gina Martin.

feeds.title: Refinery29 Beauty
feeds.description: Refinery29 is a creative global platform for ALL young people. We tell stories in our own words that enlighten, inspire, and drive change from the ground up. We exist at the intersection of style, fashion, beauty & shopping; work & money; sex, relationships & wellbeing; entertainment and gaming, and identity. As a community-driven brand, our mission is to arm you with what you and your communities need to find joy, meaning, and agency.

feeds.title: Letty Cottin Pogrebinâs Newsletter
feeds.description: Politics, culture, humor, women, feminism, Jews, Israel-Palestine & more

feeds.title: Feminism and Religion
feeds.description: Feminism and Religion is a global project dedicated to exploring the F-word in religion and the intersection between scholarship, activism, and community in the 21st century. This project was co-founded by Xochitl Alvizo, Cynthia Garrity-Bond, Caroline Kline, and Gina Messina.

feeds.title: Rage & Softness with Lachrista Greco
feeds.description: Navigating vulnerability & resistance, disability & ableism, and the ambivalence of online culture from a Marxist feminist librarian.

feeds.title: Julia Serano » Whipping Girl
feeds.description: Julia Serano is a writer, performer, and activist. Most posts focus on gender and sexuality, trans, queer, and feminist politics, music and performance, as well as other topics.

feeds.title: The Conversationalist
feeds.description: The Conversationalist is an independent nonprofit and feminist publication focused on global perspectives, from the personal to the political.

feeds.title: language: a feminist guide
feeds.description: A feminist blog about language, written by a feminist Debbie Cameron who is also a linguist. In this space, the author will try to address some frequently asked questions, debunk some common myths, and ponder some of the linguistic dilemmas confronting feminists in the 21st century.

feeds.title: Glamour UK » Feminism
feeds.description: Glamour UK is a women's lifestyle magazine that covers fashion, beauty, entertainment, and current events. It is the British edition of Glamour magazine, which was founded in the United States in 1939. Read everything Glamour UK knows about Body Positivity, including the latest news, features and images.

feeds.title: Rantings of an Aboriginal Feminist
feeds.description: Rantings of an Aboriginal Feminist is a blog by Arrernte writer and activist Celeste Liddle, offering powerful commentary on Indigenous rights, feminism, and social justice in Australia. Through a sharp, intersectional lens, Liddle critiques racism, colonialism, and gender inequality, blending personal narrative with political analysis.

feeds.title: Exponent II Blog
feeds.description: Exponent II provides feminist forums for women and gender minorities across the Mormon spectrum to share their diverse life experiences in an atmosphere of trust and acceptance. Through these exchanges, the magazine strives to create a community to better understand and support each other.

feeds.title: THE OPT OUT
feeds.description: A newsletter about womanhood without motherhood, especially as it relates to purpose, perception, and navigating our friendships

feeds.title: Feminism In India
feeds.description: Your go-to place to find feminist resources, jobs, events in your city, cute merchandise, culture, health, history, products related to women and research publications. Feminism In India is an award-winning digital intersectional feminist media organisation to learn, educate and develop a feminist sensibility among the youth.

feeds.title: Rebellious Magazine
feeds.description: Rebellious Magazine delivers a unique feminist perspective on Chicago news, events, politics and culture through original articles, essays and interviews. We support women-owned and women-operated businesses and organizations through editorial coverage and business partnerships.

feeds.title: Toxic Feminism
feeds.description: This UK-centred blog will take a sceptical approach to feminism by challenging the selective vision, or confirmation bias, of some feminists who choose to view the world through victim-tinted lenses. In particular, the selective world view held by some ultra-privileged media feminists that enables them to promote their victim status over all men, whatever their background and station.

feeds.title: Christian Feminist Today Blog
feeds.description: hristian Feminism Today blogs offer our readers a unique opportunity to experience the words of contemporary Christian feminists as they discuss a variety of compelling topics.

feeds.title: D the Vegan Feminist
feeds.description: Articles on topics like activism, women empowerment, feminism, fundraising campaign, LGBTQ, circular economy, conscious consumers, consumption, economy, entrepreneurship, environmental responsibilities and more. Founder Dagmar is a feminist who cares about human rights, women's rights and minority rights; and who stands for nonviolence, diversity and freedom of speech.

feeds.title: Crunk Feminist Collective
feeds.description: Articles on activism, film & tv, art, capitalism, religion, feminism, race and more. The Crunk Feminist Collective will create a space of support and camaraderie for hip hop generation feminists of color, queer and straight, in the academy and without, by building a rhetorical community, in which we can discuss our ideas, express our crunk feminist selves, fellowship with one another, debate and challenge one another, and support each other, as we struggle together to articulate our feminist goals, ideas, visions, and dreams in ways that are both personally and professionally beneficial.

feeds.title: Lilith Magazine
feeds.description: Lilith Magazine charts Jewish women's lives with exuberance, rigor, affection, subversion and style. The magazine features award-winning investigative reports, new rituals and celebrations, first-person accounts both contemporary and historical, entertainment reviews, fiction and poetry, art and photography.

feeds.title: The common sense feminist blog
feeds.description: The Common Sense Feminist offers a balanced take on gender equality affirming that men and women deserve equal rights while acknowledging inherent biological differences. It focuses on real-world, 'common sense' solutions like equal pay, women's education, and health, while emphasizing respect and safety for all genders.

feeds.title: Global Fund for Women News
feeds.description: Global Fund for Women is one of the world's leading foundations for gender equality, standing up for the human rights of women and girls. It campaigns for zero violence, economic and political empowerment, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

feeds.title: Feminist Campus » Quad Talk
feeds.description: Quad Talk is a weekly editorial feature that publishes short reflections, opinion pieces, and social commentary written by young feminists across college campuses.

feeds.title: Feminist Majority Blog
feeds.description: The Feminist Majority promotes non-discrimination on the basis of sex, race, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religion, ethnicity, age, marital status, nation of origin, size or disability. The Feminist Majority blog, offers timely feminist analysis and updates on key issues like reproductive rights, gender equity, and social justice.

feeds.title: Feminist Book Club Blog
feeds.description: Find the show notes and blog posts for Feminist Book Club all in one place! Feminist Book Club is the premier online hub for intersectional readers, encouraging resistance through reading.

feeds.title: rabble.ca » Feminism
feeds.description: The feminist section of Rabble.ca offers progressive, intersectional coverage of gender-related issues in Canada and beyond. It focuses on topics such as reproductive rights, gender justice, pay equity, Indigenous feminism, LGBTQ+ advocacy, and systemic inequality.

feeds.title: 7000 years of patriarchy. Until radical feminism
feeds.description: This is a radical feminist blog. '7000 Years Of Patriarchy...Until The Radical Era' is an original feminist book with daring and original analyses. Male dominance, history of patriarchy, sex vs. gender, new feminist perspectives. A ltiile science, but very friendly... toward a new feminist revolution.

feeds.title: MsAfropolitan
feeds.description: Key topics covered are feminism, pop culture, social criticism, decolonisation, sensuous knowledge and more. Minna Salami, a Nigerian-Finnish and Swedish writer, and the founder of the multiple award-winning blog, MsAfropolitan, which connects feminism with critical reflections on contemporary culture from an Africa-centred perspective.

feeds.title: Adios Barbie
feeds.description: A feminist site whose mission was to broaden the concepts of body image to include race, gender, LGBTQ, dis/ability, age, and size. Also about intersectionality, and radical self-acceptance. And while that's a mouthful, we believe that body image, like identity, happens in the mind. In fact, a person's body image has very little to do with one's actual body. Rather, it comes from external influences, beliefs, habits and conversations

feeds.title: Amy Poehler's Smart Girls
feeds.description: Articles on empowering women, diy, education, environment, LGBTQ, civil rights, personal growth, self improvement and more. Founded by artist Amy Poehler and producer Meredith Walker, Amy Poehler's Smart Girls organization is dedicated to helping young people cultivate their authentic selves.

feeds.title: The Scarlett Woman
feeds.description: The Scarlett Woman is an intersectional feminist platform combining cultural criticism, media commentary, and author interviews. Through essays and reviews, it examines pop culture, feminism, identity, and representation from a progressive lens.

feeds.title: Jane Clare Jones
feeds.description: Jane Clare Jones's blog focuses on radical and materialist feminist analysis, emphasizing the importance of understanding women's oppression through the lens of sex-based class structures rather than identity politics.

feeds.title: Fem2.0
feeds.description: Fem 2.0 is a multifaceted online magazine covering feminism alongside broader topics including activism, media criticism, identity, global women's issues, health and wellness, sexual violence, reproductive rights, and more.

feeds.title: The F-Word
feeds.description: Articles on topics such as politics, film & tv, music, life and books. The F-Word publishes feminist reviews, blogs, features, news and also promotes discussion of contemporary feminism.

feeds.title: AngryGirl Feminist
feeds.description: AngryGirl Feminist is a Radical Feminist who Speaks out against the Oligarchy and the Injustice in the World. It is time to gain our Sovereignty back.

feeds.title: FeministKillJoys
feeds.description: My name is Sara Ahmed, and this is my research blog. I am a feminist killjoy. It is what I do. It is how I think. It is my philosophy and my politics. My research is concerned with how bodies and worlds take shape; and how power is secured and challenged in everyday life worlds as well as institutional cultures.

feeds.title: Feminist Law Professors
feeds.description: This blog is an effort to build a stronger community of feminist law professors across geography, law schools, and scholarly subject areas. The overarching goal of this blog is to build a stronger feminist law prof community across scholarly subject areas.

feeds.title: Shattering the Ceiling
feeds.description: Shattering the Ceiling is a feminist blog about the obstacles that stand between us and a fair and equitable society, and about the ways we can work together to conquer those challenges.

feeds.title: UsGIRLS
feeds.description: Here at UsGIRLS, I know that sometimes all it takes to change the world is a little support. The core of my efforts is to bring equality and peace to the world to create equal opportunities for everyone. Through all of my endeavors I hope to display the conviction behind our beliefs.

feeds.title: Feminist Frequency
feeds.description: Feminist Frequency began with a borrowed camera and some lights. In 2009, Anita Sarkeesian started making videos examining pop culture from a feminist perspective. The videos aimed to analyze modern media's relationship to gender, race, and sexuality, and we have always advocated for the just treatment of all people, offline and online.

feeds.title: The Debutante Blog
feeds.description: The Debutante is an Edinburgh‑based feminist-surrealist arts platform that publishes a blend of essays, artwork, reviews, and manifestos celebrating women's contributions to surrealism and creative practice.

feeds.title: Brown Girl Magazine
feeds.description: Covers topics such as entertainment, culture, lifestyle, health, relationships, community and more. Founded as an online publication in 2008, Brown Girl Magazine is a multimedia company based in New York City with global reach dedicated to South Asian self-expression, cultural anchoring, and dialogue.

feeds.title: FEMMUSIC Magazine
feeds.description: FEMMUSIC.com is an online magazine for emerging women in music. You'll articles and information covering various female artists and their music in this magazine.

feeds.title: Feminist Majority Foundation
feeds.description: Covers articles on topics such as abortion, activism, economy, education, election, health, immigration, LGBTQ rights, politics, sports, women's rights and more. Feminist Majority Foundation (FMF), which was founded in 1987, is a cutting edge organization dedicated to women's equality, reproductive health, and non-violence. In all spheres, FMF utilizes research and action to empower women economically, socially, and politically.

feeds.title: Feminist Current
feeds.description: Unique perspective on male violence against women, pop culture, politics, current events, sexuality, gender, and many other issues that are often underrepresented or misrepresented by mainstream, progressive, and feminist media sources. Founder Meghan Murphy is a freelance writer and journalist. She completed a Masters degree in the department of Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies at Simon Fraser University in 2012.

feeds.title: BUST Magazine
feeds.description: Bust is a feminist website and magazine that offers feminist viewpoints on a variety of subjects. Dedicated to empowering women, it was founded in 1993 and features a variety of topics including pop culture, politics, art, style, and DIY projects. The newspaper seeks to empower perspectives that are frequently ignored by mainstream media and to foster a community around feminist activism and discourse.
